channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel’s Netanyahu claims Iran tried to kill one of his sons
item.description: Netanyahu's claim comes after US and Israel killed Iran's supreme leader and four members of his family in Tehran.

item.title: Man killed in world’s largest annual bullfighting event in Mexico
item.description: The world’s largest open road bullfighting event turned deadly when a 29-year-old man was killed.

item.title: Brutal gang attack on strategic Haiti hillside leaves at least 30 dead
item.description: At least 30 people have been killed in a gang attack on a hillside community that overlooks routes into Haiti's capital.

item.title: Iran war live: US slaps new sanctions on Iran, warns Tehran trade partners
item.description: US tells countries to choose between Washington and Tehran, warns Iran's trade partners they will face consequences.

item.title: How US sanctions on Iran ripple through global markets and consumers
item.description: New sanctions hit Iran's aviation, tech, and shipping sectors, amplifying pressure on global markets and energy prices.

item.title: US public support for Iran war falls as Trump approval at record low: Poll
item.description: Falling Republican support, rising gas prices, and fears of a long conflict drive a decline in backing for the Iran war.

item.title: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza face intensifying Israeli strikes
item.description: Israel struck a makeshift tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in Deir al-Balah, killing one man.

item.title: Video: Iran reacts to US ‘economic D-Day’ sanctions
item.description: Iran’s Minister of Economy Ali Madani-Zadeh has responded to the US announcement of a new economic pressure campaign.

item.title: Iran says it is ready for what US calls 'greatest financial offensive ever'
item.description: The US calls its latest sanctions on Iran an "economic D-Day", but Tehran says it has a plan to counter them.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
